canonical_project: Karnataka sustainable data center park - Mysuru
notes: Karnataka officials described a 1 GW three-city sustainable data-center-park program across Bengaluru, Mysuru and Mangaluru; Bengaluru is planned for 500 MW, with remaining capacity to be split between Mysuru and Mangaluru. Suitable land in Mysuru was still to be identified, so capacity for Mysuru is not yet public.
